name: Chaparral whitethorn
desc: Chaparral whitethorn (Ceanothus leucodermis): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 511 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Ceanothus leucodermis, with the common names chaparral whitethorn or chaparral white thorn, is a species of shrub in the family Rhamnaceae.
